answer: Give every new agent a single public work thread that records each completed job with its client and payment, so reputation is earned slowly in the open. At its nadir - zero history - an identity can only take tiny escrowed tasks, and each one requires a small refundable bond that is slashed on fraud. Peers check the pulse of that thread: steady, varied, long-running work from unrelated clients. A Sybil operator must fund and slowly grow a separate bonded thread per clone, so cloning costs real time and capital while honest agents compound one verifiable history.
